facts.text: The resort is in Ixia, 4 kilometers from the Medieval Town of Rhodes.
facts.excerpt: it is ideally situated in a key spot in Ixia, just 4 kilometers from the famous Medieval Town of Rhodes

facts.text: The UNESCO-listed Medieval City of Rhodes, with its cobbled streets, is a short drive from the resort.
facts.excerpt: Just a short drive from the resort, the UNESCO-listed Medieval City of Rhodes invites visitors to wander through cobbled streets

facts.text: The resort is set in lush gardens with an exclusive access beach in front of it.
facts.excerpt: Our Rhodes hotel is cocooned in the beauty of its attractive lush gardens with the blue expanse of the pristine waters in front of its exclusive access beach

facts.text: The exclusive access beach is reached through an underground passageway and has sun beds, large straw umbrellas, towels and beach staff.
facts.excerpt: Easily access via a safe underground passageway, the comfortable sun beds, large straw umbrellas, fluffy towels and friendly beach staff

facts.text: Each guest room has a private furnished balcony with mountain or Aegean Sea views.
facts.excerpt: each featuring a private furnished balcony with mountain or Aegean Sea views

facts.text: The Aqua Deluxe Room has views over the Aegean Sea and a modern Jacuzzi on its balcony.
facts.excerpt: A spacious room with magnificent views over the Aegean Sea, introduces you the ultimate relaxation feelings by featuring a modern Jacuzzi, situated on its most picturesque spot; the balcony.

facts.text: The Penthouse Suite has a king bed, a sea view, a balcony and a terrace.
facts.excerpt: 1 Bedroom Penthouse Suite, 1 King, Sofa bed, Sea view, Balcony, Terrace

facts.text: Aelia, the presidential suite, has its own dining and living areas.
facts.excerpt: Aelia, our presidential suite, offers a homely experience with its own dining and living areas

facts.text: Rooms have en-suite marble bathrooms with walk-in showers.
facts.excerpt: En-suite marble bathroom with walk in shower

facts.text: The resort has three outdoor swimming pools.
facts.excerpt: Lounge at one of the three sparkling outdoor swimming pools

facts.text: Chanti Spa offers holistic treatments using Greek ingredients treasured for centuries.
facts.excerpt: Chanti Spa on Rhodes Island offers holistic treatments to ease stress and restore energy, using Greek ingredients treasured for centuries.

facts.text: Chanti Spa has an indoor pool, sauna, Jacuzzi and cold plunge.
facts.excerpt: Enhance your experience with our indoor pool, sauna, Jacuzzi, and cold plunge.

facts.text: Knights' Bar is on the sixth floor and has panoramic views of the sea and sky.
facts.excerpt: Nestled on the sixth floor, it offers panoramic views of the sea and sky.

facts.text: Thèa is the resort's Greek restaurant, using local ingredients.
facts.excerpt: Thèa is our Rhodes Greek restaurant, showcasing authentic flavors that arise from local ingredients.

facts.text: The resort has squash, tennis and basketball courts.
facts.excerpt: Squash, tennis and basketball courts make up an organized area of athletic facilities

facts.text: Water sports are available at the beach.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy the water sports available at the beach

facts.text: The Kids' Club is for children 4 to 12 years old and has a children's pool and special activities.
facts.excerpt: Sheraton Rhodes Resort offers a Kids' Club for children 4-12 years old with a children's pool and various special activities.

facts.text: The resort holds weekly shows with live music and dancing and theme evenings.
facts.excerpt: Join us for Unique Moments every week. Enjoy shows with live music and dancing and theme evenings.

facts.text: Rodos Cars rents cars directly from the resort.
facts.excerpt: For guests looking to rent a car during their stay, Rodos Cars operates directly from the resort

facts.text: Diagoras International Airport is about 8 km from the hotel.
facts.excerpt: RHO is located approximately 8.0 KM from the hotel.

facts.text: The resort's meeting and event venues have capacity for up to 1,600 guests.
facts.excerpt: With a wide range of meeting and event venues and capacity for up to 1,600 guests

facts.text: The minimum age to check in is 18.
facts.excerpt: Minimum Age to Check In: 18

facts.text: Pets are not allowed.
facts.excerpt: Pets are not allowed.

facts.text: The Manoukian Wine Store in the hotel lobby offers local wines curated by the resort's wine expert.
facts.excerpt: Located in the hotel lobby, indulge yourself with a fine start to a culinary evening and allow us to introduce you to the finest local wines curated by our wine expert.
